patch_description: Replace the per-layer Python heap scheduler and exhaustive Python swap search with a batched tensorized cardinality-constrained LPT assignment. Each sorted item position is assigned simultaneously for all layers to the currently least-loaded non-full pack using a masked argmin. This preserves the greedy descending-weight and exact-capacity policy, including deterministic lowest-pack tie breaking, while eliminating `.tolist()`, `heapq`, Python list allocation, and per-layer scheduling loops. It also keeps the implementation device-agnostic, allowing callers to use accelerator tensors in the future without introducing CPU scalar synchronization.
